description: Following approval for demolition of existing houses, social club and some retail premises and the comprehensive redevelopment of Key Site 1 with the erection of a mixed use development comprising multiplex cinema, leisure and recreational facilities, town square, large retail unit, shops, restaurants, offices, hotel, health and fitness centre, creche, medical and dentistry centre, private residential,  key worker housing, together with improvements to surrounding access routes, improvements to public transport including a new pedestrian link to Hounslow Central Underground Station and the construction of two new road links between the site and the High Street, and the construction of car parks, access and service roads and landscaping  - details submitted pursuant to condition 31 - construction of each underground car park shall not commence until a scheme for its ventilation including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant and the standard of dilution expected has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, and no car park shall be used until such approved measures have been implemented
